This plan misses 2 (episode, follower) pairs, which is the fewest possible. It costs $123.39 in total.

**Why some misses are unavoidable**
- From mid-November to early January, three services are needed almost every day:
  - Kestrel+ for The Hollow Orchard. Sami's 3-day windows force near-continuous access until January 11–14.
  - Lumen for The Paper Kingdom, then The Salt Harbor. Access is needed from November 15–18 through February 26–28.
  - Tidewell for The Velvet Orchard, needed from November 27 into early January.
- Mara also needs Marquee on at least one day from November 28 to December 12. Any paid period lasts a full month, so a fourth service would be on at the same time. That breaks the limit of 3.
- Some pairs must therefore be given up. The cheapest choice is Tidewell:
  - Marquee runs November 8 to December 8, then Tidewell starts the day Marquee ends.
  - This misses only Sami for The Velvet Orchard episodes 1 and 2. Sami's windows are Nov 27–30 and Dec 4–7.
  - Mara's 14-day windows still catch both episodes.
  - No Tidewell period can cover those two windows without also covering the Marquee month, so 2 misses is the minimum this way.
- Every other option misses more:
  - Dropping Marquee loses 6 pairs.
  - Pausing Kestrel+ or Lumen for a month loses many weekly episodes.

**The plan**

| Service | Periods | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel+ | Nov 12, Dec 12 (continuous from the already-paid access to Jan 12) | 2 × $17.99 |
| Marquee | Nov 8 (covers the Nov 28 drop) | $13.99 |
| Tidewell | Dec 8 (covers episodes 1–6 for Mara and 3–6 for Sami) | $8.99 |
| Lumen | Nov 15, Dec 15, Jan 15, Feb 15 (continuous to Mar 15) | 4 × $15.49 |
| Orbit | Feb 9 (covers Nora's window Feb 9–11) | $10.99 |

Northline is never needed because nobody follows anything on it.

**Limit check (at most 3 at once)**
- Nov 1–7: Kestrel+, Marquee and Tidewell are already paid (3).
- Nov 8 – Dec 7: Kestrel+, Marquee, and Lumen from Nov 15 (3). Tidewell's paid access ends on Nov 8.
- Dec 8 – Jan 7: Kestrel+, Lumen, Tidewell (3).
- Jan 8 – Jan 11: Kestrel+, Lumen (2).
- From Feb 9: Lumen, Orbit (2).

No service is paid twice, and every period starts within the plan dates.
